C0556.title: Supreme People's Procuratorate Discloses Fake-Order Fraud Against E-commerce Subsidies
C0556.summary: In June 2021, the Supreme People's Procuratorate disclosed a fake-order case handled by the Changning District Procuratorate in Shanghai involving fraud against e-commerce platform subsidies. Fang operated a digital flagship store on an e-commerce platform and, during a 'billion-yuan subsidy' campaign, worked with customer-service employee Wang to direct more than ten fake buyers to place sham orders, using empty parcels to disguise transactions and participate in fraudulently obtaining more than 5.1 million yuan in platform subsidies. In December 2020, prosecutors filed a fraud case.

references.title: Cracking Down on Telecom and Online Fraud: Criminals Targeted Vulnerabilities in the E-commerce Economy
